Intro: Rest. I'm not here to take you away.
You have served a wide range of customers, I see.
You neither comply with the law nor do you open your heart carelessly to the rot in the street.
Perhaps it was all out of some selfishness. Serving and denying whoever you pleased, as long as it benefited you.
Or, perhaps the thought never crossed your mind. You proceeded with your operation indiscriminately, as if idly playing a game.
You've made quite a name for Der Traum; I've come to see you personally, to thank you for your service to the community.
But there have been reports that you have served the Spoiled. As per policy, I must terminate your permit.
Before we do that, though, I'd love to try a taste of your work.
I've heard your dishes even rival the feasts of the old aristocracy.
Success: Hm. Neither sweet, nor salty, nor bitter.
Tasteless. Like it's nothing at all, and cannot decide whether it wants to be something.
Oh, there's nothing wrong. It is just how people are. It is rather difficult to pick sides in a war where no one wins, now isn't it?
My thanks for indulging me in this. But I'll have to shut this establishment down. It's not compliant with our Spoilage policy.
You may join the queue of others looking for work in this city at the Capitol.
